name: Octree-based Volume Rendering with Delta/Residual Tracking
definition: A volume rendering approach that replaces volume meshes and volume stacks with an octree encoding volume topology and extra data, enabling direct traversal and shading during ray marching.
summary: Octree-based Volume Rendering with Delta/Residual Tracking replaces volume stacks with an octree, evaluating all leaf node shaders simultaneously to eliminate stack maintenance during ray marching.
